# Charge-only facing partition; no palette or gameplay writes.
rule object blip-charge-facing-partition
when 0x2C00 == 0x4B48
when 0x2C02 == 1
when 0x0240 in 2 3
when 0x043A == 0xA2
match palette 2 tiles 0x34 0x34
art hidden.bin 8 8 hidden
anim hidden 0:hidden
play hidden

# Blip feedback showcase: 17 prior body frames preserved; cosmetic charge, measured release.
# Generated by build.py; runtime anchor intentionally differs from art ground pivot.

rule actor blip-body
when 0x2C00 == 0x4B48      # helper form state valid (ROM hack BW-RAM)
when 0x2C02 == 1           # helper form = Blaster
when 0x0240 in 2 3         # slot 04 is a live helper
match palette 2 tiles 0x20 0x3F    # native helper body objects
art body.bin 32 32 idle0 idle1 walk0 walk1 walk2 walk3 jump fall attack0 attack1 hurt land0 land1 land2 dash0 dash1 dash2 charge0 charge1 charge2 charge3 fire0 fire1 recover0 recover1
palette 2 1466 0EFF 339F 05FB 0934 2CA3 6DC6 7FD1 777A 5A51 3D49 7FFF 0CDF 03FF 025F
actor 0x0896 0x0910 0x135E 0x1360 0x043A   # helper X, Y, camera X, Y, pose
anchor 16 17
anim idle 30:idle0 30:idle1
anim walk 6:walk0 6:walk1 6:walk2 6:walk3
anim jump 0:jump
anim fall 0:fall
anim attack 6:attack0 0:attack1
anim aim 7:charge0 6:charge1 6:charge2 7:charge3 6:charge2 6:charge1
anim hurt 0:hurt
pose idle 0x58 0x3A 0x5E
pose walk 0x64 0x66 0x68 0x6A
pose jump 0x6C
pose fall 0x6E 0x48
pose attack 0x86 0x88 0x8C 0x8E 0x96 0x98 0x9E
pose aim 0x90 0xA2
pose hurt 0x24 0x26 0x28 0x2A
anim land 3:land0 2:land1 0:land2
anim dash 4:dash0 3:dash1 4:dash2
pose land 0x36
pose dash 0x4C
anim fire 3:fire0 2:fire1 3:recover0 0:recover1
pose fire 0x8A
default idle

rule object blip-bolt
when 0x2C00 == 0x4B48      # helper form state valid (ROM hack BW-RAM)
when 0x2C02 == 1           # helper form = Blaster
when 0x0240 in 2 3         # slot 04 is a live helper
match palette 1 tiles 0x48 0x4F    # helper FX page (helper-owned shots)
art bolt.bin 16 16 bolt0 bolt1
anim shimmer 4:bolt0 4:bolt1
play shimmer
